title: Scheme-theoretic density in a generic fibre spreads over an open subset of an irreducible base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: A topologically dense open need not detect embedded or nilpotent structure, so a finite algebraic injectivity test must be built. The proof encodes the generic density by multiplication with finitely many functions, applies generic flatness to the algebra and cokernel, and transports the exact injection to every fibre on the chosen open.
